cd: CD means being one hundred more than three hundred.
CD can also mean a soft bluish-white ductile malleable toxic bivalent metallic element.
CD can also mean the basic unit of luminous intensity adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites.
CD means the same as four hundred or 400 or cadmium.
cd-r: CD-R is a compact disc on which you can write only once and thereafter is read-only memory.
CD-R means the same as compact disc recordable or CD-WO or compact disc write-once.
cd-rom: CD-ROM is a compact disk that is used with a computer.
CD-ROM means the same as compact disc read-only memory.
cd-rom drive: CD-ROM drive is a drive that is connected to a computer and on which a CD-ROM can be `played'.
cd-wo: CD-WO is a compact disc on which you can write only once and thereafter is read-only memory.
CD-WO means the same as CD-R or compact disc recordable or compact disc write-once.
cd4: CD4 is a glycoprotein that is found primarily on the surface of helper T cells.
For example: "CD4 is a receptor for HIV in humans."
CD4 means the same as cluster of differentiation 4.
cd4 cell: CD4 cell is T cell with CD4 receptor that recognizes antigens on the surface of a virus-infected cell and secretes lymphokines that stimulate B cells and killer T cells.
CD4 cell means the same as helper T cell or helper cell or CD4 T cell.
cd4 t cell: CD4 T cell is T cell with CD4 receptor that recognizes antigens on the surface of a virus-infected cell and secretes lymphokines that stimulate B cells and killer T cells.
CD4 T cell means the same as helper T cell or helper cell or CD4 cell.
cd8: CD8 is a membrane glycoprotein that is found primarily on the surface of cytotoxic T cells.
CD8 means the same as cluster of differentiation 8.
cd8 cell: CD8 cell is T cell with CD8 receptor that recognizes antigens on the surface of a virus-infected cell and binds to the infected cell and kill it.
CD8 cell means the same as killer T cell or killer cell or cytotoxic T cell.
cd8 t cell: CD8 T cell is T cell with CD8 receptor that recognizes antigens on the surface of a virus-infected cell and binds to the infected cell and kill it.
CD8 T cell means the same as killer T cell or killer cell or cytotoxic T cell.
cd burner: CD burner is recording equipment for making compact disks.
CD burner means the same as compact-disk burner.
cd drive: CD drive is a drive that reads a compact disc and that is connected to an audio system.
cd player: CD player is a stand-alone piece of electronic equipment that either has its own display or attaches to a television set.
cdc: CDC is a federal agency in the Department of Health and Human Services.
CDC means the same as Center for Disease Control and Prevention.
cdna: CDNA is single-stranded DNA that is complementary to messenger RNA or DNA that has been synthesized from messenger RNA by reverse transcriptase.
CDNA means the same as complementary DNA.
